schedule.rule: Committee seats are elected at the general primary: the third Tuesday of May in even-numbered years, or the fourth Tuesday of April in presidential years. Nomination petitions circulate from the 13th Tuesday through the 10th Tuesday before the primary. Vacancies between elections are filled under county party rules, usually by appointment.
